Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 24-Dec-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CSE STREAM) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: MIE 1072/MIE_1072 - BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING SCIENCE  
  (MAKEUP/REGULAR)  
  
  
  BASIC MECHANICAL ENGINEERING SCIENCE [MIE 1072]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               An internally-fired boiler produces 50 kg steam at 230°C having an energy content of 125 MJ. The        (4)  
  steam is then led into a superheater through a pipe and during its passage, the steam condenses  
  onto the walls of the pipe. The steam of 95 MJ enters the superheater and leaves with an energy  
  content of 150 MJ. If the feed water temperature is 30 °C, calculate the following:  
  i) Total heat supplied within the boiler  
  ii) Condition and related parameter of the steam at the exit of the pipe  
  iii) The degree of superheat  
  
  
1B)               A crude oil distillation unit operates a 4200 kg/h steam generation capacity boiler which produces   (3)  
  dry steam at 1.3 MPa. The boiler burns 1850 kg/h of wheat straw having 18 MJ/kg of calorific value.  
  The feed water is drawn from a nearby reservoir with an average temperature of 28°C.  
  i) Compute the boiler efficiency  
  ii) If the steam pertaining to the above conditions is to be produced by using an economizer which  
  consumes 22% less fuel and increases the feed water temperature to 70°C, compute the change  
  in boiler efficiency.  
  iii) For case a, if the boiler efficiency is to be improved by 5% in absolute terms without changing  
  the condition and production rate of the steam, compute the wheat straw consumption rate.  
1C)               Justify the following statements through appropriate reasoning:                                         (3)  
  i) Operating boilers at higher pressures brings down the fuel costs  
  ii) Feed check valve is a non-return valve.  
  iii) Feed water treatment is mandatory for water tube boilers.  
2A)               A flat belt drive system is used to transmit power from an electric motor to a conveyor belt in a     (4)  
  packaging facility, with both pulleys rotating clockwise. The driver pulley has a diameter of 350 mm,  
  while the driven pulley on the conveyor belt has a diameter of 700 mm. The motor shaft rotates at a  
  speed of 180 rpm and the centre distance between the two pulleys is 1200 mm. Calculate the  
  speed of the driven pulley, the power transmitted, and the length of the belt. Assume the slack side  
  tension is 250 N and the coefficient of friction is 0.32  
2B)               Ten gear wheels are available, labelled A to J, with the number of teeth as 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 84, (3)  
  94, 98, 68, and 34, respectively. Design a simple gear train using these gears to achieve the lowest  
  possible speed at the driven shaft. Additionally, design a compound gear train to meet the same  
  requirement. Determine the percentage change in the output speed between the simple and  
  compound gear trains. The driving shaft rotates at 2880 rpm.  
2C)               Prove that the idler gears in a simple gear train do not influence the velocity ratio                   (3)  
3A)               An I.C. engine with a compression ratio of 10:1 is fitted with a heavier flywheel. Identify, sketch and (4)  
  explain the working principle of the given engine.  
  
  Page 1 of 2

3B)   An IC engine having a cam shaft and a piston diameter of 100 mm is operating with a mean piston        (3)  
  speed of 900 m/min. It consumes fuel at the rate of 0.0013kg/sec. Determine the indicated thermal  
  efficiency if the mean effective pressure is 0.68MPa and the calorific value of the fuel is 44 MJ/Kg  
3C)   Identify the IC engine component which is used to                                                      (3)  
  i) Seal the combustion chamber.  
  ii) Receive the gas pressure.  
  iii) Store the lubricating oil.  
  iv) Convert linear motion into rotary motion.  
  v) Facilitate opening and closing of valves.  
  vi) Provide energy to the piston during idle strokes.  
4A)   A R717 refrigerating machine works on a vapor compression cycle. The temperature of the                (4)  
  refrigerant in the evaporator is -20⁰C. The vapour is dry saturated when it enters the compressor  
  and leaves it in a superheated condition with a superheat of 6⁰C. The condenser temperature is  
  30⁰C. Assume the specific heat at constant pressure for R717 in the superheated condition as  
  1.645 kJ/kgK.  
  i) Plot T-S and p-h for the cycle.  
  ii) Determine the condition and enthalpy of vapour at the entrance to the condenser  
  iii) Determine the condition and enthalpy of vapour at the entrance to the evaporator.  
  iv) Determine the coefficient of performance of this machine.  
4B)   Discuss the working principle with neat sketch of a domestic refrigerator.                             (3)  
4C)   Explain the following:                                                                                 (3)  
  i) Why the temperature of the refrigerant in the condenser is generally higher than the ambient  
  temperature?  
  ii) Does boiling point of the refrigerant have any effect on the refrigerating effect.  
  iii) Specific volume of the refrigerant should be low for a refrigerant. Why?  
5A)   Define the following with examples:                                                                    (4)  
  i) Open system  
  ii) Closed system  
  iii) Clausius statement of 2nd law of thermodynamics  
  iv) Convection heat transfer  
5B)   List and brief any three features of CNC control system                                                (3)  
5C)   Using a flow-chart, discuss the steps involved in fabricating an object using additive manufacturing   (3)  
  technique.
